heroSummary: Jeffco Public Schools begins the 2027–28 school year on Wednesday, August 18, 2027, and the last day is Thursday, May 25, 2028. Fall Break is October 11–12, Thanksgiving Break is November 22–26, Winter Break is December 20–January 4, and Spring Break is March 20–24.
heroFactChips: Potential snow make-up days: Feb 18, Mar 27
calendarNotes: Jeffco’s 2027–28 family calendar lists February 18 and March 27 as teacher staff development days that may be used as snow make-up days. It also lists teacher staff development on October 12 and November 1, in addition to the August and January staff-development windows.

sourceReviewSummary: Verified against the Jeffco calendar page and the official 2027–28 English family calendar PDF.
sourceReviewDetails: Reviewed against the Jeffco calendar page and the official 2027–28 English family calendar PDF.
The PDF lists 79 first-semester student contact days and 92 second-semester student contact days.
The PDF marks October 12, February 18, and March 27 as teacher staff development days.
The PDF lists Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Day Observed, New Year’s Day, and Juneteenth as legal holidays.
Because this is a future-year calendar, families should re-check the Jeffco calendar page before making final plans.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Jeffco Public Schools start in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Jeffco Public Schools begins the 2027–28 school year on Wednesday, August 18, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Jeffco in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day is Thursday, May 25, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When are Jeffco’s winter and spring breaks in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 20, 2027, through January 4, 2028, and Spring Break runs March 20–24, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: What are Jeffco’s potential snow make-up days in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Jeffco lists February 18 and March 27 as teacher staff development days that may be used as snow make-up days. Families should check district updates before assuming students will have those days off.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the downloaded Jeffco calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The .ics file is a one-time import and will not automatically update if Jeffco Public Schools revises the calendar.
